claims: Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 in the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game on March 17, 2026.
Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic title.
Eugenio Suárez hit an RBI double in the top of the ninth inning to break a 2-2 tie.
Eugenio Suárez's RBI double scored Javier Sanoja.
Bryce Harper hit a 2-run home run in the bottom of the 8th inning to tie the game.
Wilyer Abreu hit a home run.
Venezuelan pitching held the U.S. scoreless for the first six innings.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game took place in Miami
